articleTitle: Recommended 5G frequency bands evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: For the development of mobile communication systems of fifth generation (5G) a number of frequency bands are currently proposed in Russian Federation. Since the 5G standard does not yet exist and the requirements for 5G systems are very wide, a detailed analysis is needed to select the frequency band for 5G networks. The article presents the main problems that should be solved in order to implement 5G and whether its requirements can be achieved in the recommended frequency bands. Evaluation of the possibility of using each band was made with regard to the corresponding problems, system goals and link budget estimation. MmWaves may be recommended for the stationary network devices, while for mobile services it is proposed to use frequencies below 6 GHz.

articleTitle: Measurement accuracy analysis for on-board measuring devices
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of accuracy and reliability of measurement results of on-board measuring radio-electronic equipment is considered. The analysis of the accuracy of the measurement of the range by a radio frequency range station placed on a mobile object under the influence of interference is carried out. We show that there is a nonlinearly increasing dynamic error if the optimal filter was constructed without taking into consideration of the elements nonideality. So precision of distance measurement of mobile radio-range station depends on the interference. This example emphasizes the importance of the quality problem of components used in onboard equipment and establishing tolerances for component parameters.

articleTitle: Frequency extension circuit for EER transmitters operating with electrically short antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern high-efficiency EER transmitters to comply with the standards for electromagnetic compatibility require very precise matching with the load. The antennas used on board are often electrically short and therefore narrow-banded. Traditional LC-matching in some cases can not provide the required level of SWR. A method for matching electrically short narrow-band antennas with the help of RLC-circuits is proposed. It allows providing the required SWR value of the load not more than 1.05 in the band of the OFDM signal of 10 kHz and not more than 1.1 in the band of 20 kHz. A technique for designing a RLC frequency extension circuit is developed. The carried out analysis of the energy efficiency of the frequency extension circuit showed that if the antenna 3-dB bandwidth exceeds 10 kHz, the losses in the FEC do not exceed 1 dB. The developed method for calculating the frequency extension circuit was tested for Digital Radio Mondiale (DRM) LW broadcasting stations. The possibility matching of existing antennas with a height of 257 meters for the DRM mode with 9/10 kHz signal bandwidth over the entire range of LW is shown. Also, the potential for using Simulcast mode with a dual signal bandwidth is shown: for the upper half of the low-frequency range, with antennas 257 meters high and 378 meters for the lower one.

articleTitle: Practical aspects of increasing the spectral efficiency of PSK-n-signals due to intersymbol symbol interference
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers some practical aspects arising from the use of “transparency windows” (range of symbol time durations of information sequence when error probability per symbol due to intersymbol distortion is zero) to increase spectral efficiency in radio communication systems using multiposition phase-shift keyed signals with n discrete states. The functioning of communication systems was analyzed in the presence of frequency detuning and error produced by phase meter for various amplitude-frequency responses of a linear radio path. The admissible operating conditions and gains in information transfer rate of such systems are determined.

articleTitle: Poly-Gaussian models in describing the signals of Lorenz dynamic system
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Singling out the characteristic areas with typical dynamics in Lorenz system signals by means of non-harmonic spectrographic analysis, a method of representing the distributions of signal probabilities has been developed. Interconnections have been established between the singled out areas of Lorenz system typical dynamics and distribution of probabilities. The minimal number of poly-Gaussian components, necessary for representing the signals with required accuracy, has been assessed.

articleTitle: Generation of pseudo-random signals based on a modified Lorenz system, realized over a Galois finite field
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The new class of modified Lorenz system based pseudorandom numbers generator, realized in Galois Field was considered. Modification is based on realization of Lorenz system in Galois Field and making all operations of sum and multiplying in these Fields. Perfection and depreciation of digital element base does actual realization of shapers of multilevel chaotic signals on the basis of algorithms of the numerical decision of systems of the differential equations describing systems with dynamic chaos. In article the analysis of statistical characteristics of a new class of pseudorandom numbers generator is carried out. Base statistical properties of modified Lorenz system based pseudorandom numbers generator, realized in Galois Field were estimated. Correlation intervals of signals were estimated. Probability distributions of the generated numbers are considered.

articleTitle: About features of evaluation of the quality of generation and signal processing at stage transformations in wiring and optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In modern wireline and optical communication systems, issues of assessing the quality of signal transmission are very relevant. To assess this, the article investigates the influence of coding methods on the quality of received signals, taking into account the features of signal transformations in various metric spaces, in particular, for analog-digital transformations. Analytical expressions are obtained showing the limits of achievable quality depending on the established risk indicators and the type of errors occurring in the digital signal.

articleTitle: TOA measurement processing analysis for positioning in NLOS conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we present the analysis of time of arrival (TOA) analytical positioning algorithms in mobile communication networks, as well as the dependence of positioning accuracy on the number of sources with non-line-of-sight (NLOS). Proposed simulation model established sufficient number of base stations for correct mobile position estimation that provides computational complexity reduction. Taking into consideration statistical estimation theory obtained results and correlations of root mean square error (RMSE) were confirmed by Cramer-Rao bound.

articleTitle: TDOA positioning accuracy performance evaluation for arc sensor configuration
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we present time difference of arrival (TDOA) positioning accuracy performance evaluation for the case, when sensors are arranged in arc configuration. Performance evaluation is implemented through simulation model including TDOA system and link level model subsystems. TDOA system level model represents radio links between transmitter (emitter) and receivers (sensors) in 2-dimensional layout taking into account actual pathloss. TDOA link level model represents signal modulation, sampling rate, additive noise and cross-correlation calculation. Resulting estimates reveal twentyfold RMSE increase for the case of arc with respect to round sensor configuration.

articleTitle: Positioning of the radio source based on time difference of arrival method using unmanned aerial vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we estimate the accuracy of the fixed and moving radio source based on Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA), using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in three-dimensional space. We estimate the coordinates of an unknown radio source using the nonlinear technique. Nonlinear Least Squares is the nonlinear technique that has been used to estimate the coordinates of the unknown radio source. The obtained estimates for the case with UAVs and stationary receiving points are compared, and the obtained estimates are compared for different versions of the UAV trajectory. Based on the results of the simulation is shown that the use of UAVs improves positioning accuracy more than 6 times: from 60 meters for a scenario of five fixed receiving points to 9 meters for a scenario of three stationary and two UAVs.

Author Keywords: the trajectory of movement of the radio source

articleTitle: Effective precoding and demodulation techniques for 5G communication systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Multiple-Input Multiple Output (MIMO) is the key technology in most advanced wireless communication standarts like 3GPP Long Term Evolution (LTE) and IEEE 802.11n/ac (Wi-Fi). MIMO provides the better performance in terms of data rates and spectral efficiency. The cost of MIMO improvements is increased computational complexity of the signal processing at both ends and, as a consequence, growing complexity of the hardware. Increasing number of antennas in MIMO systems will make MIMO systems difficult to implement.

articleTitle: The concept “fog computing” — The evolutionary stage of development of infocommunication technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper Considers the continuing development of information and communication technologies in the context of the concept of the Internet of things, as well as the processing and analysis of large amounts of data, which led to the emergence of foggy calculations-a necessary condition for the further development of the concept of the Internet of things as a solution to the problem of increasing the bandwidth of data channels, which is required for intelligent terminal devices (IOT objects).

articleTitle: Multiple frequencies analysis in FBG based instantaneous frequency measurements
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes the design principles of instantaneous frequency measurement system of microwave signals based on the use of amplitude-phase modulation conversion of single optical carrier into symmetrical dual-frequency ones for additional frequency separation according its wavelength range, and same its modulation by unknown frequency and subsequent “frequency-amplitude” measurement conversion in fiber Bragg grating with Gaussian reflection profile. Distinction and measurement of the instantaneous frequencies made depending on the amplitudes, modulation indexes and form of the signals on the difference frequency envelope of unknown frequency components, received at the photodetector in two separated ranges 0,25-12,5 GHz and 12,5-25 GHz. Such approach increases the SNR and allows measuring of several unknown frequencies simultaneously vs classical IM-DD approach in FBG based systems of given type. From another side this method realization have to use expensive wideband photoreceiver. The main purpose of article is to show how to decrease bandwidth of system photoreceiver in two times.

articleTitle: Resource development to prevent riots at mass events
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, the main communication means and management of the participants behavior in mass events, including unauthorized ones, are portable mobile devices, through which, in the social network framework a, text messages are sent to manipulate people's behavior. In the article the problem of mass events participants binary classification on representing and not representing a threat is considered. A convolutional neural network is used as a classification tool. The system of loading and processing data from a social network, the neural network architecture a and the results of experiments are described.

articleTitle: Wideband signals dispersion distortion compensator based on digital filter banks
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article proposes a device for compensation of dispersion distortions, based on the modification of the classic M-channel system of digital banks of analysis and synthesis with an ideal recovery. The modification consists in adding additional compensatory delays and phase shifts in the synthesis channels, determined by the calculation method, depending on the slope of the frequency dispersion of the ionospheric channel.

articleTitle: Modeling of information impacts on elements of onboard system
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the article the questions of modeling of counteraction to negative influence in the information sphere are considered. The main models as a system of differential equations is presented. The experiments based on the developed models have been implemented with the use of the Anylogic simulation platform. A comparison has been made between the agent models and the system-dynamic models which showed a high degree of agreement between them and with statistical data. On the basis of the cluster analysis method, typological groups have been identified in a selective set of objects with a different mean time of propagation of the information impacts. Models for dissemination of the information impacts have been successfully tested. The models allow the forecasting of information impacts (II) and information counteractions (IC), to play different scenarios of their dynamics, to manage the corresponding processes.

articleTitle: Automated support system designing for people with limited communication
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes designing, modeling and testing of automated gesture recognition system, with access and control from wearable mobile devices. It will help people with disabilities to communicate with people who do not understand gesture language. For example, during a painful attack on Board the aircraft to ask doctor help. The developed system consists of subsystems that perform tasks of authorization, recording, storage and conversion of video, sending data to the server and recognition. The neural network with error back propagation is used for recognition. The topology of the used neural network is the perceptron. This is a prototype system that works under light conditions, and in the future will be refined.

articleTitle: Researches of initial value of the Brillouin frequency shift in optical fibers of different types
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The dependence of the hyper-acoustic wave velocity on characteristics of the optical fiber core is analyzed in this article and the values of Brillouin frequency shifts for different types of optical fibers at room temperature and without strain are presented. Having database of profiles of the Mandelstam - Brillouin backscattering spectrums for different type fibers and manufacturers allow to classify the optical fibers in the optical cables and detect damaged sections of fiber optical communication line. The work was performed with the financial support of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Russian Federation (Project No. 8.9334.2017/8.9).

articleTitle: BPSK signal shaping and processing for digital SDR ionosonde
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents the algorithms of BPSK signal shaping and processing for vertical incidence ionospheric sounding with the use of a hardware platform USRP which implements SDR technology. The principle “ADC to an antenna”, which provides completely digital processing, allows to apply new algorithms. The developed algorithms allow to obtain a quality images of ionograms with the use of low-power signals (less than 20 W). The algorithm of coherent spectral integration, which causes the increase in the SNR, and the algorithm of narrowband interferences mitigation, which uses median equalization, are presented. The efficiency of the algorithms was verified in the full-scale experiments on vertical incidence ionospheric sounding in Yoshkar-Ola.

articleTitle: Exponential approximation by the ξ-transform method: Theory and applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The new method of interpolation/approximation of single-dimension functions by the exponential polynomials (in the general case, complex polynomials) is suggested. A solution is based on the ξ-transform od complex functions, which are given by the discrete set of equidistant samples. This problem is solved for dynamic systems with fundamental frequencies of any order. The operator model of the high-frequency front-end is synthesized for the on-board receiver of the data transmission system.

articleTitle: Bran collective dynamic routing optimal routes evaluation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The purpose of the work is to design the algorithm that will allow to reduce the size of the collective dynamic routing optimal routes sets. The article contains the analysis of recurrent metaheuristics-based algorithm that was designed earlier. It is shown that it defines the routes sets that transmit more information than it is needed. That fact leads to the routes sets size and information delivery time increasing. The modified recurrent algorithm was designed. Its main feature is constraints of information to be transmitted. This feature allows to reduce the size of the optimal routes set and also the computational complexity of its definition procedure. In the MATLAB software environment, optimal routes sets size and computational complexity of the exact branch and bound method and recurrent metaheuristics-based algorithm are compared, as well as a modified recurrent algorithm. Obtained results showed that the introduction of the constraints in the modified algorithm makes it possible to approximate the size of the optimal routes sets to the solutions obtained by exact method and further reduce the computational complexity. Therefore designed algorithm is useful for decreasing the information delivery time and computational complexity.

articleTitle: “Surdotelephone” project with convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of the adaptation of disabled people in society has become very relevant nowadays. All new technologies are being invented to help such people. In emergency situations, they need to contact the relevant services on time, as well as transfer their location to them. The article describes the design and development of the algorithm for recognizing dactyl signs of sign language based on a convolutional neural network. This work has a direction in the field of telecommunications, as well as in the field navigation algorim.

articleTitle: Ways of integrating information, controlling and telecommunication systems — Based on ground and on board — On a process basis
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article reviews the problems of development of ground and on-board based information, controlling, and communication systems as a part of general controlling system; that is a complex of controlling bodies, points and tools, and respective organizational, technical and technological processes. The development of abovementioned systems is based on the process approach to their integration.

articleTitle: Compact highly-selective microstrip filters based on counter-comb structures
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper examines the design principles of microstrip filters with increased frequency selectivity based on compact structures with a significantly limited number of resonators. It is shown for the first time that in four-resonator counter-comb structures with an additional galvanic connection between adjacent resonators, it is possible to form four working attenuation poles at finite frequencies. The conditions for creating on the basis of these structures microstrip filters with increased one-way frequency selectivity and with a quasisymmetric characteristic are given.

articleTitle: Resource control system stability of mobile data centers
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The mobile data center is the basis for building systems with a network-centric architecture. The system for managing the resources of a mobile cloud data center redistributes the computing resources of the data center in accordance with the needs of applications to meet real-time requirements. Resource management is carried out by moving virtual machines from one server to another, which can be located in another data center of the network-centric system. In this paper, we consider the architecture of the cloud data center resource management system using live migration of virtual machines. It is shown that reverse migrations violate the stability of resource management system. In order to reduce the number of reverse migrations, better forecasting is required while determining server overload/underload and when selecting a destination host. The proposed method of determining the stability criterion will minimize the reverse migration flow, which, with a probability of at least 0.9, will make it possible to consider a sustainable system for managing virtual resources of the data center.

articleTitle: The efficiency of the DPI system for identifying traffic and providing the quality of OTT services
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this article, the authors introduce a definition of the term OTT service, describe the attendance of these services and compare them with traditional attendance. Also here is shown the classification of services provided by OTT-services. In this article, the authors identify the problems related with the data transfer through the telecom operator networks. Authors show different classes of traffic priority, based on the requirements and behavior of certain types of applications, allowing maximum flexibility in the transmission of user information. Due to this for the necessary correction of the network's work, the authors give perspective approaches and DPI-technology procedures which provide the necessary requirements for Quality of Service when they make provision of services of its network for OTT-services. The authors review the possibilities of using the DPI-system on the network and its interaction with OTT-services based on open solutions. In this paper, we obtained graphs of the results of the experiment and reviewed the efficiency of signatures, derived formulas for estimating the probability of events, and applied them to the suitable statistical analysis.

articleTitle: Two-frequency radiation forming on chirped FBG for tuning terahertz carriers generation
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the promising methods for generating continuous sub-terahertz radiation is the method of photomixing, when the photoconductive material is excited by the emission of two optical continuous lasers with frequencies separated by terahertz frequencies. It should be noted that for effective photomixing the polarization, frequencies and phases of the optical beams introduced into the mixer must be constant, otherwise it is necessary to additionally use a complex system of phase synchronization. In connection with the complexity of such an implementation, variants based on the conversion of single-frequency and broadband laser radiation into two-frequency ones were investigated. The first of these is modulation and consists in the external modulation of single-frequency laser radiation in the electro-optical Mach-Zehnder modulator. The second one is broadband with the allocation of two wavelengths using two rectangular fiber Bragg gratings with a small difference in width. The studies were carried out to create a terahertz photoconductor, the distinguishing feature of which is the use of heterostructures grown on a GaAs substrate in the low-temperature regime as a photoconductive material in the form of a thick gradient layer In(x)Al(1-x)As (x = 0 → 1) with artificially created local deformations and with photoconductive composite InGaAs / InAs / InGaAs quantum wells.

Author Keywords: formation of spaced windows of transparency in fiber Bragg gratings

articleTitle: On-board brain-computer interface based on the recognition of patterns of brain activity through a convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents the prototype of brain-computer interface (BCI), designed to control on-board systems. BCI functions of the basis of an artificial convolutional neural network that recognizes the patterns of activity of the human brain. The device is characterized by a high-precision classifier of brain activity patterns, as well as high quality and stability of recording brain activity signals. The results of the recognition quality obtained during the experiment are presented.

articleTitle: The usage of neural networks for mathematical model of autonomous objects
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article deals with the problem of using neural networks for choice the optimal path for autonomous transport object as a part of control system projection for technical objects. The static and dynamically obtained data about the operating environment is used. This method makes possible to remove the restrictions on the movement and to choice the optimal path taking into account real dimensions of autonomous object. A functional is proposed that provides a minimum of energy costs for movement, provided it is safe. It makes possible to find a decision in true time. A neural network providing the choice of the site of motion is given. Examples of operation of the algorithm for various operating conditions are given.

articleTitle: The control of onboard computer network
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An approach to the control of an onboard computer network based on the principles of control theory is proposed. The state space of network and the set of controls divided on subsets, allowing for configuration and operational control of the network.

articleTitle: Irregular spatial color sampling in video single matrix sensors
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the space orientation options in state-of-art unmanned aerial vehicles is done by the analysis of visual signal from one or more on-board television cameras. These methods are usually based on contour recognition. Using color filter arrays for acquiring color information lead to spatial separation of components and result in distortions that may be quite high on images with periodical structure and appearance of false contours moving on image scaling and decreasing reliability of orientation methods. This problem can be solved by using irregular structure of arrays designed in the article.

articleTitle: Increasing the efficiency of the functioning of transport communication networks by using a modified method for determining a set of independent routes
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the process of forming a stream structure by a modified method is considered. The method specified in the article allows to effectively allocate network resources. It consists of two algorithms: Modified algorithm for determining all possible routes by the integral criterion of the cost function and Modified algorithm for selecting the most successful subset of routes.

articleTitle: Analytical modeling of call admission control for real-time and elastic services in inter satellite link
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The model of joint servicing by inter satellite link the real time traffic and elastic data traffic is proposed. Flow of requests for real time servicing is described by Poisson model (narrowband traffic) or Engset model (broadband traffic). Flow of requests for data transmission is described by Poisson model. Real time traffic has advantage in occupying link transmission resources. It exhibits itself in decreasing if necessary the speed of data transmission to some minimum value. When link has free capacity the speed of data transmission is increasing. The duration of servicing of requests for real time traffic transmission has exponential distribution and doesn't depend on model's state. The duration of servicing of requests for elastic data transmission also has exponential distribution but with parameter depending on available free link transmission capacity. In framework of the proposed model the definitions of main performance measures of traffic transmission are formulated through values of probabilities of model's stationary states. The algorithm of estimation the introduced performance measures based on the solving the system of state equations is suggested. The proposed model and the results of its analysis can be used for estimation the required transmission capacity of inter satellite link for given volumes of real time and elastic traffics.

articleTitle: An analysis of the mandelstam — Brillouin scatter spectrum for distributed irregularities detection in optic fibers
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Researches results of bends impacts of optical fibers on Brillouin reflectograms are presented in this paper. A mathematical modeling of Brillouin backscattering in optic fibers is discussed. The test results confirmed advantage of the Brillouin reflectometry method for early diagnostics of fiber-optical communication lines. The work was performed with the financial support of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Russian Federation (Project No. 8.9334.2017/8.9).

articleTitle: Architecture of the regional transport navigation and information systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes the main principles of architecture design at development the transport navigation information systems in the Russian Federations.

articleTitle: A quick method of calculation the Shannon performance of twisted pair channel of “long” Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The Shannon performance express-evaluation algorithm is considered on the assumption that network interfaces Fast Ethernet signal transmission cable channel is constructed on electrically conductive symmetrical hardware components: twisted pair cable and modular connector (IEC 60603-7-2 or similar). The method applies to cable channel constructed using a direct connection scheme is demanded when developing promising information systems based on IP-equipment to connect single remote terminal devices to the information system.

articleTitle: Program complex for designing cm-and mm-range traveling-wave tube
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper describes concept of program complex's composition which is used for traveling-wave tube (TWT) with resonator slow-wave structures and designing and implementating models for this complex. Projects of cm-range and mm-range TWT developed with program complex “VEGA” are presented.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of FMF refractive index profile deviation from the optimized form on DMD degradation
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This work presents results of simulation and research on 16-LP-mode few-mode optical fiber (FMF) differential mode delay (DMD) spectral curve degradation due to refractive index profile local deviations from the optimized form.

articleTitle: Methodology development and implementation of protected hardware and software platform based on the existing
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Offers basic methodological approaches to the creation of new platform solutions to create a secure automated systems. The common application of the methodology is determined by the results of analysis, generalization and systematization of the basic and functional requirements of modern it solutions. The methodology reflects the design features of hardware and software solutions based on modern approaches of computer and software engineering in terms of universality of open source code development with the existence of partially ready-to-implement developments.

articleTitle: Studying the algorithms of processing a FMICW signal for vertical incidence ionospheric sounding with the use of a single antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The algorithms of processing of frequency modulated interrupted continuous wave (FMICW) are presented to solve the problem of ionospheric sounding with the use of a single antenna. Short-period and long-period pseudo-random sequences (PRS) for switching transmission and reception were studied. The efficiency of weighting the sequence edges when switching was investigated.

articleTitle: Spectral efficiency of fiber-optic data transfer systems: Four modifications
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The fiber-optic data transfer systems spectral efficiency factor widening conception is proposed. Two kinds of signal transmission rate, - bitrate and baudrate, - and two kinds of spectrum definitions, - frequency and wavelength, - are being analyzed associated with the spectral efficiency factor. Four modifications of spectral efficiency are designed based on four pair transmission rate - spectrum combinations. In addition to the classic spectral efficiency SE the combination set includes: baud efficiency BE, spectral - wavelength efficiency SWE and baud - wavelength efficiency BWE. The transmission rate influence on spectral efficiency factor modifications is being analyzed. Conception of complex multiplexing is being used for fiber - optic data transfer systems transmission rate forming mechanism modeling.

articleTitle: Software applications of infocommunication networks. Approaches formation to developing models and methods of evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Research subject of this article is the evaluation of the digital quality of services, which are software-defined applications of infocommunication network. It suggests some approaches to the definition of models and methods of comparative evaluation of modern and advanced digital services quality. Also the functional scheme is proposed and the model of the geographically-spaced system based on the Microsoft Azure cloud platform is developed. The study is the first stage in the development of appropriate application systems for the comparative assessment of the quality of providing services for software-defined applications.

articleTitle: An assessment of the availability factor of fiber-optic communication lines with consideration of external actions and diagnosis errors
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A method of the determination of the fiber-optic communication lines reliability taking into account the effect of the optical fiber tension, the temperature influence and the built-in diagnostic equipment errors is discussed in this article. The reliability is assessed using the theory of Markov chains and probabilistic mathematical modeling. The reliability is assessed in terms of the availability factor. According to the permissible value of the availability factor, it is possible to determine the limiting frequency of the maintenance of fiber-optic communication lines. The work was performed with the financial support of the Ministry of Education and Science of the Russian Federation (Project No. 8.9334.2017/8.9).

articleTitle: Radiation investigation of the antenna array, taking into account vibration actions
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A mathematical model of two-dimensional waveguide-slot antenna array radiation is proposed, which allows to take into account the three-dimensional nature of its deformations arising from external actions. The article shows the results of the study of the vibration actions on the design (structure) and characteristics of the antenna array radiation installed on a moving object in its typical frequency range and amplitudes. The influence of the arising deformations on the electrical characteristics of the antenna array is estimated.

articleTitle: About the unified system of classification of protection of automated control systems and infocommunication systems by the criteria of importance and of information security
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work presents the results of the development and joint application of a single network security trust model and a unified classification system of the protection of elements of information infrastructure of management based on a new approach accounting to the importance of elements in a classification system.

articleTitle: Simulation of two-mode fiber optic link with chromatic dispersion compensation at line amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper present results of simulation of the two-mode fiber optic link with the chromatic dispersion compensation. There were considered two variants of chromatic dispersion compensation. The one of variants is the compensation at the end of fiber optic link. And other is compensation at line amplifiers. It is compensation on coarse maps. It is shown that the chromatic dispersion compensation even on coarse maps only on line amplifiers much more effective then compensation at the end of fiber optic link.

articleTitle: Redundancy of optical fibers in underwater cables
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Nowadays underwater optical cables have the total length of over 300,000 kilometers and they ensure communications between dozens of countries and continents divided by seas and oceans. Reliable operation of such cables is the key objective in the course of designing of communications lines. This article deals with issues of redundancy in underwater optical cables.

articleTitle: Modeling of radio channels of millimeter waves range
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals with the methods of creation of the simulator for the new fifth generation of mobile communication (5G) radio channels. The authors propose the multipath architecture of the simulator, that allows to simulate the attenuation of the millimeter wave signal when the subscriber moves receiving both direct and reflected signals. The attenuation of the signal is modeled depending on the interval and the profile of the communication path and the change in the probability density of the transfer function when the subscribers move and the change of locations and conditions for the reflection of propagating signals.

articleTitle: Simulation of effectiveness of the channel resources evaluation algorithm founded on the basic model of multiservice network
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article is meant to share our experience on simulation of effectiveness of the channel resources evaluation algorithm. Post-correlation mathematical models are offered to solve the problem of channels evaluation in non-Poisson distributions of intensity.

articleTitle: Antenna pattern retrieval from measurements in non-ideal anechoic chamber
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The study focuses on the measurement procedure and the algorithm for retrieval of the true radiation pattern of the antenna from data measured in non-ideal environments, which are insufficient distance from the source antenna and scattering from the walls of the chamber. Unlike the previous works, a concept of converging cluster of plane waves used not only to approximate the primary illuminating field, but also to account for waves reflected from the measuring chamber walls. In addition, expansion in the number of basis functions instead of a set of points represents the sought-for antenna pattern. This leads to bettering the reconstruction algorithm stability. The results of modeling various tasks illustrate how interesting can be relief of fields brought forth by clusters of waves inside and outside the test zone.

articleTitle: Direct digital synthesizer for radio communication systems with programmable tuning of the working frequency
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers techniques of forming the signals with a frequency-hopping spread spectrum. The advantages of systems with FHSS during electronic warfare systems jamming are shown. A new structure of the direct digital synthesizer of frequency-modulated signals that have the high frequency tuning rate is offered.

Author Keywords: radio communication systems with signal spectrum broadening

articleTitle: Principles of cyber-physical models mapping onto sonification sound spaces
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The Industry 4.0 actively changes the existing technological paradigm. The IoT, USN and Big Data together form the basis of the Cyber-Physical Systems, the main driver of the Industry 4.0 world. Meanwhile, we still depend a lot on a human operator inside the complex systems. The research of auditory representation, i.e. sonification, can provide us the new forms of data and systems monitoring. The paper presents the results of the research of sonification application to the cyber-physical systems.

articleTitle: External electromagnetic fields influence upon moving objects
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Number of moving objects (satellites, aircrafts, trains, vehicles and so on) rises continuously in the space at earth surface and nearby. This space is filled by radiation and electromagnetic fields of natural and artificial sources. The external electromagnetic fields have an influence upon communication equipment and instruments of moving objects, that can to pose severe hazard to them. The most troubles are brought by lightning discharges, that are source of current, fields, x-and gamma-emission. In this paper there are some aspects of possible impacts considering.

articleTitle: Low latency ONM video compression method for UAV control and communication
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we consider a method for compressing a digital video stream in a television link for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control using psychophysical features of the human eye that allow, without complicating the equipment, to achieve higher visual image quality results and at the same time do not require high latency and computational complexity. It is achieved by dividing the fields into groups. There are fields of 3 types in a group: O-fields, which play the role of support; even N-fields coded by prediction-based compression using the previous field within one frame; Odd M-fields coded by prediction-based compression using the previous odd field from another frame. The proposed methods increase the efficiency of digital stream compression in a television link.

articleTitle: Model of the corporation information subsystem functioning
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To ensure the information provision to consumers of corporation systems, information subsystems are created. In modern conditions, taking into account the rapid development of information technology, the requirements for the promptness of providing consumers of corporation systems with required information were increased. With growth of transmitted information volume and number of applications for its receipt, as well as an increasing of the probability of external influences on information systems, the fulfillment of these requirements becomes problematic. There is a need to use new functioning algorithms and creation of hardware and software systems that allow efficient functioning of the corporation information subsystem in different conditions. This work is devoted to the development of the model of the corporation information subsystem functioning, taking into account the possibility of external influences on its components.

articleTitle: Method of back-oblique sounding of the ionosphere in HF-range for operational compensation of measurement errors of early-warning radars
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: At present, there are a fairly large number of methods of ionospheric measurements, which use radio waves: radiosonde, partial reflection method, coherent and incoherent scattering of radio waves methods, various phase methods (dispersion interferometry, Doppler measurements) and etc. Modern methods of radiosonde, carried out from one point, includes four types of radiosonde: vertical - ground, oblique, external and transionospheric. Back-oblique sounding can also be included here, which can be implemented by the same radiophysical complex. From the point of view of compensation of measurement errors of early-warning radars, the oblique and back-oblique sounding methods are optimal, because these methods make it possible to obtain operative estimates of the ionosphere state in a given direction (including at low elevation angles). One of the most promising methods back-oblique sounding of the ionosphere is the method of estimating the electronic concentration in the ionosphere according to scattered by the ionosphere signal. The aim of the article is to assess the possibility of application the method of estimating the electronic concentration in the ionosphere according to scattered by the ionosphere signal for quickly compensate of measurement errors of radiolocation early-warning station. The signal reflected by the ionosphere consists of a mirror-reflected component and a component caused the scattering. The parameters of the scattered signal component depend on the type of single ionospheric irregularities. The results of numerical modeling of the process of the reflection of the HF signal from the ionosphere show that there is the possibility of detecting the scattered by ionosphere heterogeneity of the components of the sounding signal at the point of ionoprobe placement at a high sensitivity of the receiver. Such an approach will significantly improve the efficiency of measuring the ionosphere parameters in a given direction.

Author Keywords: ionospheric scattering of a radio signal

articleTitle: FBG based brush length sensors for onboard measurement systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article deals with development of new type of onboard measurement system for carbon brush's length (wear) measurements. There are many applications where regular inspection is not feasible because of a number of factors including, for example, time, labor, cost and disruptions due to down time. Thus, there is a need for an on-board system that can monitor the brush's length to calculate it's wear rate, while the component is in operation or without removing of the component from its operational position. We propose a novel method for characterization of carbon brush's length. This method based on the usage of advantages of the multiplicative response of FBGs and FBG arrays: spectral parameters depend on several aspects, such as grating's period, refractive index, it's physical length and so on. We are the first, in our point of view, who proposed to use third parameter for sensing application and prospectively all three parameters for complex measurement: the change of FBG's length is used to measure length of the brush and it's wear rate, grating's central wavelength shift for temperature (due to refractive index change) and mechanical stress (due to grating's period variations) measurements. The results of modelling and experiments are presented.

articleTitle: Mobile networks subscribers search time analysis using roaming
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the trends in modern communication networks, combining both elements of fixed access and elements of communication with mobile subscribers. The article analyses the difficulties of network management, as well as potential problems in the medium-and long-term. There is a significant increase in the number of subscribers in the medium term, during the implementation of the concept of the Internet of Things and Industrial Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Ways of operational measurement parameters of pollution of the environment and data transmission by onboard communication system
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Methods and methods for monitoring environmental parameters using a computer information measuring system are proposed. Special service functions have been developed, according to which the measurement process takes place automatically without operator involvement. Studies of the impurity concentration in the aqueous medium by a direct method using ion-selective electrodes have been carried out. The verification of the correctness of the results was done by the method of additives, that is, by measuring the known concentration of the component against the background of an unknown part of it in the test solution.

articleTitle: Radiated signal models
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Emitted radio signals classification on the basis of ability to factorize their analytical representation to spatial and temporal was considered. Four types of emitted radio signals were classified as result of instantaneous antenna diagram equation analysis. Only one of them is able to be representing as the product of antenna diagram and temporal signal function. Other types are not factorized by spatial and temporal arguments. Emitted radio signals factorization of spatial and temporal arguments was given. Also an example of space-time emitted signal forming was given.

articleTitle: Measuring flat surface reflectivity with the help of an open resonator
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The recently proposed method of accurate measuring the electromagnetic reflection from a flat conducting sample is the matter of our investigation. The method is especially useful if the sample is made of a composite material or a metal mesh. The core part of the relevant measuring setup is a special open resonator comprising a sample under test. It features a good sensitivity due to multiple reflections in the cavity and absence of any contact between the sample and the installation. We used geometric optics to replicate the electromagnetic field in the cavity of the resonator. That leads to a convenient data processing algorithm. Measurements of the frequency response of the resonator using ZVA 50 signal analyzer and digital modeling with the CST Microwave Studio software confirmed the proposed technique. We defined a statistical criterion to assess sensitivity of data processing results towards measurement errors, and used it to find out the limitation on combination of resonator sizes and a frequency band, which prevents occurrence of ill-conditioned situations.

articleTitle: Modeling of a slot spiral antenna in a multilayer structure
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Presented work considers the solution of the problem associated with planar slot spiral antennas which is solved based on the construction of the Green's function tensor elements of a multilayer substrate with magnetic current. It is based on duality principle. The solution of obtained integral equation for magnetic current is carried out on the basis of a self-regularization principle. The results of the calculation are given for slot spiral antenna with two dielectric layers as a substrate and one dielectric layer as a cover.

articleTitle: Method for forming of the plan for distribution of applications for information provision in the information system
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper the information system is a set of hardware and software that provide storage, transmission, processing of information, and information technology processes. In the context of the complexity of information technology, the control task in the modern information system becomes one of the most important. At the same time it is necessary to ensure the functioning of an information system with specified performance indicators under conditions of mass perturbations. One of the main tasks of controlling the functioning of the information system is the task of controlling parameters that characterize the functioning of the system. This task can be solved through the development of special procedures for the forming the plan for the distribution of applications for the provision of information services. The plan for the distribution of applications for information provision of officials is formed at each of the points on which these officials are located. In this paper, a method is presented for the formation of the plan for the distribution of applications for the provision of information in the information system, which allows changing the order of the transfer direction of applications to specific nodes providing information services, depending on the quality of service of previous applications.

articleTitle: Justification of the method and device structure to speed up of gold sequences delay acquisition
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Object of consideration — asynchronous-address systems, using code division of channels. A subject of the analysis — the quasi-orthogonal signals ensembles based on the Gold sequences providing reliable division of channels at influence of imitation interference, signal-like noises and devices of their processing. The analysis purpose — optimization of the Gold sequences delay acquisition procedures, capable to adapt to change of structure of the signals that make up the ensembles. The solution is based on the principles and mathematical models developed by authors: the principle of the fast conversions in Galois fields, algebraic model of representation and structure of fast delay acquisition devices for a subclass of the sequences based on the Gold sequences. The problem arises when using the very long sequences in the conditions of limited time of signal observation, high requirements to reliability and accuracy of synchronization, and also structural secrecy of the considered systems. In these conditions use of the various simplified procedures of fast delay acquisition is limited due to their low energy efficiency, while optimum parallel procedures are too difficult for implementation. The problem significantly becomes complicated when is needed achieve synchronization with a quasi-orthogonal signals ensemble, including signals ensemble with dynamically changeable structure applied in the conditions of influence of signal-like noises. This article is devoted to create of a processing method and model of a delay acquisition devices based on the fast conversions in Galois fields, close by efficiency to the optimum parallel scheme, and capable quickly adapt to use and (or) change of structure of Gold sequence on the basis of which ensembles of quasi-orthogonal signals make up. Key features of the described method of processing are implementation of correlation reception of set of synchronized short sequences samples having identical structure with accumulation of symbols from multiple copies of short sequences received from initial Gold sequence. The used principles of separate synchronization on delay components and fast conversions in Galois fields provide a big variety of options to create a delay acquisition devices providing a compromise between the speed and complexity of delay acquisition as it is reached in the known serial-to-parallel schemes. It is shown that the offered delay acquisition devices model for the considered subclass of signals provides the high level of adaptation to change of a signal structure. The offered versions of the scheme of delay acquisition carry out reception and preprocessing of code sequences in real time that favorably distinguishes them from the known schemes, which are carrying out fast conversions by other methods. In particularly, there are no memory devices for storage of the accepted sample at a detection stage that usually is required at accomplishment of fast conversions by other methods. On the basis of the analysis of essential properties of fast conversions in Galois fields perspectives of additional decrease in time expenditure on delay acquisition of the difficult multicomponent constructions which are based on M-sequences are defined. Presented results will be useful to the specialists who are engaged in design of the asynchronous-address systems using aggregate signals with large base and changeable structure for ensuring protection against influence of signal-like noises.

articleTitle: Graph-matrix model for broadband channel partition in a complex IoT solution
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Wireless access technologies in the Internet of things solutions (IoT) are key in the digital transformation of the economy. This is mainly due to the need for the IoT solution elements to access the control system at any time in any place with guaranteed required quality. The network infrastructure in the IoT solution is created on the basis of package technologies and implements the principles of self-organization. Radio access standards in such a network infrastructure are a specialized technology designed to solve certain types of tasks, fully or partially supplementing other standards and being interchangeable in various solutions. New technologies in wireless communications offer additional opportunities and requirements for self-organizing networks. In the absence of the established network infrastructure inherent in traditional wireless networks, the most important for managing wireless self-organizing networks is the media access control protocol (MAC). The MAC protocol in the IoT wireless network allows nodes to access the media and manages the signal power. Due to the absence in many such cases of a central dispatcher the regulation of user access to the wireless environment requires a more complex, distributed control mechanism at the MAC level. The MAC protocol, in fact, can be considered as the main characteristic of a particular wireless access technology. The key factor for medium access protocols for IoT networks is the actual method of using the transmission medium. Early methods used a common media environment for all nodes, modern approaches can use multiple channels for more efficient use of the environment, but due to simplicity, shared access to the environment continues to occupy a significant position. The article proposes a graph-matrix approach for modeling the functioning of a IoT network.

articleTitle: The tasks of modeling the changes in audiences of modern information and communication services by methods of cellular automata
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses questions of audiences of modern information services [1], put forward proposals to deal with these problems for services of next generation networks. The problem defined in this research is studying of the ways for prediction of behavior of telecommunication services. Consider traditional analytical and computational methods of modeling consumer audiences as applied to the field of info-communication services, substantiates new approaches to solving these problems. Research materials could be useful for traditional telecommunications companies and providers of «over-the-top» services.

articleTitle: Cupper and fiber-optic cables in moving objects
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers the application conditions of copper cables, microwave and fiber-optic cables on various civil and military of mobile objects: aircraft, ships, trains, space objects, it is noted that the network of mobile objects based on symmetrical copper and coaxial cables and fiber-optic solutions. In many aviation, missile and marine applications, optical connectors replace copper cable connectors, and in terms of volume and footprint, they should take up less space along with optical cables, and the requirements for them should be very high.

articleTitle: Regular mixed-radix DFT matrix factorization for inplace FFT accelerators
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The generic vector memory based accelerator is considered which supports DIT and DIF FFT with fixed datapath. The regular mixed-radix factorization of the DFT matrix coherent with the accelerator architecture is proposed and the correction proof is presented. It allows better understanding of architecture requirements and simplifies the developing and proving correctness of more complicated algorithms and conflict-free addressing schemes.

articleTitle: An acoustic tomography method for extracting speech patterns from noisy speech
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The hypothesis that the auditory system is structured on the principle of a tomographic system has been made on the basis of the procedure analysis of speech signal transformations on the auditory periphery and comparison it to the algorithms of tomographic reconstruction of hidden from direct observation regularities. Is true the given study works out aspects of generating some projection data, e.g. sensor channel signals that characterize a reproduced speech pattern from a particular perspective related to the resonance frequency of the amplitude-frequency-altitude characteristic of an acoustic detector. A digital acoustic tomography algorithm was developed and studied.

articleTitle: Direct digital synthesizer for radio communication systems with a spread specrum
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers methods of signal spectrum spreading, which served the basis for creating a new block diagram of the direct digital synthesizer of frequency-modulated signals. The offered structure of DDS has the increased operation speed and it allows forming multiple frequency frequency-modulated signals. The direct digital synthesizer is created for the synthesis of signals with frequency modulation and it can be used in radiolocation, navigation and adaptive broadband communication systems with a spread spectrum.

Author Keywords: radio communication systems with a spread spectrum

articleTitle: Parameters monitoring methods for the DWDM systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Upon transition to new generation telecommunication networks it is important to have management and supervision for all network levels. Therefore the problem of monitoring of parameters of the FOTN base network with wavelength division multiplexing is of great importance. Bases of this mechanism which are used for creation of control systems of communication networks of new generation are given in article.

articleTitle: Organization of work process with external storage during execution of measurements of time-varying physical quantities
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is concerned with carrying out tests connected with registration of the block of time-varying physical quantities in field environment. The possibilities of signal generation for their transmission, storage and display are considered. Researches of particularities of creating protocols for the exchange of information directly from PC, SD memory card and serial EEPROM memory were conducted. The main causes of failures in operations were identified. The developed flexible data management system was used in work with the information obtained from the equipment for cone penetration testing. The method allows you to connect additional sensors and accumulate test statistics. According to research results, the greatest prospects for operation in difficult conditions has using of EEPROM memory microchips with serial access, as non-volatile, compact, easy to install and allowing over one million cycles of re-recording. Laboratory and field tests of the created equipment enable to judge the operability and reliability of the proposed scheme. The method of receiving and processing of signals was used in the equipment for cone penetration testing, produced by LLC “Scientific and technical center PIKA-TECHNOSERVICE”.

articleTitle: Scan blindness in one-layer microstrip antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the problem of scan blindness in microstrip antenna arrays leading to the deterioration of radiation pattern for a range of scanning angles. The anticipated future wide implementation of integral antennas for mobile and fixed service communication systems with beamforming and MIMO capabilities requires the analysis of this problem and the means to combat it. Analysis of this problem and a method to determine blind scan angles are given as well as relationship between one-layer dielectric substrate parameters and element spacing is obtained and presented in the form of curves of maximum permissible scan angles.

articleTitle: Quality assessment of video information in infocommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the stages of the television systems development and the corresponding quality assessment criteria. The calculation of the number of three-dimensional image depth plans based on the statistical data of stereo threshold allowing to improve their quality is presented. The results of experimental studies of the television and network parameters influence on the three-dimensional television image quality are presented. Ways of the video information estimation development in infocommunication systems are shown.

articleTitle: Reduction of the number of guard intervals in the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: It is proposed to reduce the number of guard intervals in the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing by using a preliminary estimate of the channel pulse response in the receiver and the subsequent comparison of the sequence of information signals transmitted over the radio channel, with all possible values of sample signals.

articleTitle: Waveguide termination with a magnetic wall on the mushroom-shaped metamaterial modeling
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Waveguide termination modeling with a mushroom-shaped wall were carried out. Voltage standing-wave ratio (VSWR) and reflection coefficient (S11) frequency dependencies were obtained. High values of the mushroom-shaped structure unloaded quality factor are the main advantage of explored design. The using of distributed LC-resonant circuit with dimensions which significantly smaller than wavelength allows creating a compact termination working in microwave range.

articleTitle: Analysis of the time of hierarchical distributed search for subscribers in next-generation mobile communication networks
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: B The article describes a hierarchically distributed way of storing and processing mobile subscribers location information. Proposed a method to determine the time of information search about the mobile subscriber location of a upon a call. The analysis is presented of time dependence of the location information search to the number of subscribers of the communication network changes.

articleTitle: Excitation of the isotropic two layer media with linear dependence of impedance and of the isotropic one layer media along propagation direction by radio impulse
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: As one means to solving propagation problems are considered modeling of electromagnetic wave in inhomogeneous layered media. There are exact relations for the field exciting by the plane monochromatic electromagnetic wave in flat-layered one-dimensional inhomogeneous isotropic media is used in this paper for analysis field structure in media with linear dependence characteristic impedance along propagation directions.

articleTitle: Applying AODV and OLSR routing protocols to air-to-air scenario in flying ad hoc networks formed by mini-UAVs
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: After small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) or drones became commercially available, it has opened new prospects for their applications in emergency recovery, search and rescue operations, event tracking, and goods delivery. Flying Ad hoc Networks (FANETs) is a version of a popular mobile ad hoc network (MANET) paradigm. It is concerned with the deployment of multiple small UAVs. FANETs possess some unique characteristics, if compared to other kinds of ad hoc networks, and create some major challenges to the research community. One of the problems is designing FANET routing protocol. The protocol must form an effective route between UAVs and adapt it to the rapidly changing topology in real time. The performance of AODV and OLSR routing protocols in mini-UAV ad hoc networks is investigated with ns-2 simulation tool. In this paper, AODV and OLSR routing protocols were studied in order to choose the best of them for flying ad hoc network of mini-UAVs.

articleTitle: Legacy applications model integration to support scientific experiment
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the implementation of the integration model of legacy applications to support a scientific computer experiment. The model is based on the microservices architecture using the Docker containerization technology. The information system was developed on the basis of the proposed integration model. It integrates legacy applications through a unified interface that works on HTTP protocol and allows you to remotely manage complex, time-consuming and resource-based computer experiments remotely using a mobile application. The article also describes infrastructure services, in particular, a load forecasting service that automatically adds processing power in the case of a large number of requests from users, which makes the developed system stable and increases its fault tolerance.

articleTitle: Inner parameters' optimization in the artificial neural network for the traffic data classification in radiofrequency applications: Classification of nonstationary data using the machine learning algorithm “random forest”
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The number of devices connected to the World Wide Web and the requirements of subscribers to the speed of mobile Internet access are increasing every year. Developers of telecom equipment and telecom operators, trying to meet new challenges, are preparing to seriously change the architecture of networks and interaction regulations in radiofrequency applications. Availability of required radiofrequencies in radiofrequency applications is one of the main necessary factors for the development of such networks, along with the readiness of the network architecture and infrastructure, business models and subscriber devices [1]. In the development of fifth-generation technologies in radiofrequency applications, there is a certain set of “input” characteristics that serve as a guide for a new standard. For example, compared to the best existing LTE networks, the data transfer speed in 5G networks should be 10–100 times higher, the response time is 5 times less, the network should support the number of devices 100 times more[2-4]. The modern telecommunication market is at a stage when operators have a favorable opportunity to bypass all the convergence difficulties inherent in the networks of the past, and go directly to the next-generation networks based on technology, which received the working name NGN — “New Generation Network”. In order to make this breakthrough and join the number of high-tech operators, new solutions are needed to be constructed in the field of creating and providing high-performance services. NGN — technology of building a network — is designed to provide data transmission services and voice services in radiofrequency applications. It removes a number of restrictions and barriers that exist now, and this is its economic productivity[4]. DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) — technology for the classification and filtering of traffic by its content. DPI is able to define application protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, Skype, BitTorrent), the type of data transferred (web pages, audio and video files), it can extract information specific to specific protocols (URL for HTTP, domain name for HTTPS, distribution identifier BitTorrent). At the moment, most Russian providers use DPI as a means of blocking websites from a single register of prohibited information. The use of DPI for this purpose allows providers to block specific links made to the registry, rather than an IP address or a whole domain[1-4]. Having enough data about the traffic data related to the user, it is possible to successfully determine the thematic categories reflecting the interests and preferences of this user or detect risky activities. In the process of choosing the optimal model for traffic data analisys the so-called “random forest” algorithm was chosen due to the accuracy quality and equation stability: a large number of parameters affecting the implementation of the task are taken into account for solving the classification problem[2].

Author Keywords: recommendations of new services to the telecommunications market

articleTitle: Optimized data protection and network attacks' analysis throughout security classes identification with machine learning methods in radiofrequency applications: Data protection and network attacks' analysis in radiofrequency applications
publicationTitle: 2018 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Network attacks are as diverse as the systems against which they are directed.
